title: Bangkok: Life Along the River of Kings
summary: From Rattanakosin Island and the Grand Palace to Wat Arun and Wat Pho, journey through the sacred monuments along Bangkok's historic Chao Phraya River.

fields.director_notes: Prompt: Adapt the procedural ink knowledge showcase workflow (chronicle-ink) to chronicle Bangkok's sacred architecture along the Chao Phraya River. MiniMax M3.1 Flash role: Directed historical facts research across Britannica and Wikidata archives, verified claims on King Rama I (1782), Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun; authored bilingual captions and camera choreographies across canvas ink wash scenes. Audio: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration synchronized to historical milestones.
fields.my_city_line: Where the River of Kings remembers: Bangkok.
